hypothesis: In the currently accepted real-KH path, run FFT product then fused K+H on one scoped branch while independent A and G2 queries start immediately. Remove the current product-before-all-queries barrier without changing arithmetic, threads, query shapes or scratch policy.
distinction: Earlier four-separate-query overlap screens were marginal and one warm-pressure test failed; they are not rerun or overwritten. This source has a combined K+H stream, Euler product, new G2 prefix kernel and current entry policy. Exactly one H-first product/fused-KH schedule is tested against current accepted and fresh sequential controls; no order/worker/parameter sweep.
scope: Native Linux canonical-wire internal randomized proving only when existing fused_kh::eligible is true and product query has the full plan domain. Public five-part, mismatched scale, larger queries, generic and portable paths retain the sequential path.
enable: New compile cfg zopro_fused_product_overlap; runtime ZOPRO_CPU_FUSED_PRODUCT_OVERLAP=1 latched once per process, default absent/0 OFF. No per-proof flag string allocation after first use. Disable overlap whenever any active proof selected existing allocator reclamation.
memory: Only existing borrowed key/scalar slices and moved a/b/product vectors. No extra worker, key point copy, table, retained result, auxiliary heap buffer or key plan. Existing workspace forecast sums FFT fields and all MSM parents plus per-worker leaf scratch, so concurrent FFT/MSM lifetimes are already conservatively included. Its total must remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Existing reclamation decision is advisory at branch start; no claim of rescheduling after pressure arrives mid-request.

validation_before_timing.field_validation: Inherited only after exact source and linked accepted field identity audit; no field arithmetic change.
validation_before_timing.activation: Primary ON preflight trace must confirm overlap; primary OFF absent; all ineligible shapes stay sequential.

latency.order: Rotated/reversed separate processes; fixed before observations.
latency.cases: All nine Euler shapes at32workers with31measured+3primes; primary at16workers CPUs0-15 with101measured+3primes.
latency.exclusions: Key load and primes only; no excluded observations or unchanged reroll.
latency.gates: Primary32 and original-eight median-of-block-geomeans improve versus both controls with at least4/7block wins; everycase<=2%pairedmedian and<=5%everyblock regression versusboth; OFFcalibrationfactor<=1.03; no positive-gain floor.

before_adoption: If fixed speed gate passes, independently qualify public/generic/uncached/admission-denied paths, native+portable APIs, one-worker/concurrent callers, cold memory pressure and warm limit transitions under default and retained heap. Check forecast source identity and actual branch fallback. Current negative experiments do not authorize skipping these checks.

research_review.sqisign: https://arxiv.org/html/2608.13948v1; inspected field representation and special-prime reduction; not evidence for a BN254 gain
research_review.morph: https://arxiv.org/html/2604.17808v1; inspected arithmetic/dataflow challenge; TPU-oriented, no imported CPU speedup claim

reporting: Retain all receipts, pins, failures and observations. Commit and push each completed experiment including negatives before another experiment.
